assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game UI background, one fixed straight-on terminal, landscape 1536x1024 canvas.
Primary request: A post-apocalyptic NecroTech computer terminal for a retro DOS character intake screen. Full frontal orthographic view, absolutely no perspective tilt. A broad, old beige-grey CRT monitor chassis fills nearly the whole image. Heavy settled grey-brown dust in the bezel edges, ventilation slits and corners, subtle chipped paint, tiny screws, aged plastic, understated blue power light. Beautiful atmospheric realistic painted game art, tactile aged hardware, controlled detail.
Composition: wide rectangular monitor only, no keyboard or desk or room. Entire chassis visible within the canvas. Large recessed screen occupies the rectangle approximately x=230 to 1306 and y=155 to 805 on a 1536x1024 canvas. Screen is a completely blank near-black rectangle with softly rounded corners and only extremely faint blue edge glow. Broad unobstructed usable black text area. Bottom chassis strip carries small worn manufacturer label "NecroTech". Dust mainly on hardware and the outermost screen edges; clean black screen center.
Color palette: charcoal black glass, dirty warm-grey chassis, desaturated dusty brown, very restrained NecroTech blue accents.
Constraints: fixed single frame. No interface, no prompts, no characters, no ASCII art, no screen text, no keyboard, no objects in front of screen. No dramatic reflections. No bright white glass sheen. Transparent outside silhouette; opaque black glass center. Actual alpha transparency outside chassis, not a checkerboard.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent RGBA game screen dust overlay, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: ONLY delicate static dust and smudges on an old post-apocalyptic CRT screen, seen straight on. This is an alpha overlay to place OVER blue terminal text, never a finished screen picture.
Composition: a flat rectangle with irregular fine grey-brown dust accumulated at the extreme outer edges and corners, quickly fading to complete transparency inward. Only a few very faint translucent isolated dust flecks and hairline scratches within the middle. At least the middle 80 percent must be almost fully transparent. No visible frame.
Color palette: muted ash-grey dust, sparse warm-grey grains. Low opacity. Minimal.
Constraints: Actual transparent background everywhere except the dust particles. No black background, no glass backing, no solid panels, no blue image fill, no text, no hardware, no border line, no opaque vignette, no checkerboard. A reusable dust-only compositing texture.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent monochrome ASCII/PETSCII confirmation-screen frame for a retro computer game.
Primary request: a crisp single-color NecroTech-blue Commodore 64 style character-cell graphic, landscape 1536x1024. Sparse double-line rectangular border constructed entirely from tiny repeated plus signs, equals signs, pipes and square character blocks, inset 6 percent from all edges. Small pixel ASCII skull motif centered in the top border, with geometric pixel circuit branches running left and right along the top. The skull occupies only the top 18 percent. Tiny block ornaments at bottom corners. The entire central 75 percent is EMPTY and completely transparent, reserved for separately rendered names.
Style: strictly flat 1980s monochrome character graphics, consistent aligned character grid, hard square pixel steps, one hue medium luminous blue (#579bff). Transparent negative spaces throughout. No gradients, no shadows, no glow.
Constraints: no background, no black panel, no hardware, no words or letters, no headings, no numbers, no names. Only the delicate ASCII perimeter and small centered skull. Real alpha transparency.
assets.revision_prompt: Edit this transparent ASCII frame asset. Remove ALL blue haze, ALL blurred light and ALL glow. Change only the haze and graphics clarity: retain the same perimeter geometry and top-center pixel skull, but render them with perfectly crisp opaque single-color #579bff edges. Every pixel outside the actual tiny strokes and skull blocks must be alpha=0. The blank center AND all gaps between strokes AND the outer area must be totally transparent. No black background, no blue background, no semiopaque panel. Strict pixel art, no soft edges. The output is ONLY thin blue character-cell border strokes and a small solid blue pixel skull on transparent canvas.
